dividers_tutorial.title: Dividers
dividers_tutorial.text.0: In this level you have access to a new tool - Dividers!
dividers_tutorial.text.2: Dividers block the movement of Guests and Staff just like walls. However, unlike walls, they allow people to view and access the objects immediately on the other side.
dividers_tutorial.text.4:
There are lots of uses for Dividers, for example, you can place them around decorations so that Guests can enjoy them, but don't go wondering among them.

Dividers can be found under the Infrastructure section of the build menu. Experiment and have fun, what will you use Dividers for?
